name: omniroom
description: Virtual staging for furniture and home decor: place a product photo in a styled room, recolour it, create white-background catalog shots, six product or room angles, and matching sets.

interface.longDescription:
OmniRoom does virtual staging for furniture and home-decor sellers: it turns a product photo into professional, marketplace-ready imagery. It focuses on keeping the product's shape, proportions, colour and materials consistent while placing it in new scenes.

Share a product photo (paste an image URL or attach it) and OmniRoom can:
- Stage it in a styled room (Scandinavian, modern, boho and more) at true-to-life scale, with a clean straight-on front view by default.
- Recolour it from a colour palette or your own uploaded swatch while keeping its geometry.
- Produce clean white-background catalog photos suitable for marketplace main images.
- Generate a six-angle product sheet, or six camera views of the whole staged room.
- Build a coordinated matching set from one hero piece or several products.

Results appear in an interactive card with one-tap options (another room, real size, colours, catalog shots, room views, matching sets) and a watermarked preview you can download.

defaultPrompt: Put this sofa in a Scandinavian living room. Photo: <paste an image URL>
Give me a clean white-background catalog photo of this product. Photo: <url>
Show this product from six catalog angles. Photo: <url>
